name: Erie (United States)
description: Dark blue field with a red stripe fimbriated in white near the top and bottom, charged with the city seal in white reading CITY OF ERIE PENNSYLVANIA ESTABLISHED 1795 INCORPORATED APRIL 14, 1851.
history: Erie is a city on the south shore of Lake Erie and the county seat of Erie County, Pennsylvania.
